title: QuincyHUB  OP BRING GOD MODE
features:
KEY IS ON DISCORD SERVER!!!


🎯 Main
Kill Aura: Automatically attacks nearby enemies.

Features an adjustable range slider.

God Mode: Makes the player invincible.

Destroy All Meteors: Automatically destroys all active meteor nodes on the map.

✨ Visuals
ESP (Entity Highlighting)

Chest ESP: Highlights all unopened chests.

Child ESP: Highlights lost children that can be rescued.

Cultist ESP: Highlights Cultist and Crossbow Cultist enemies.

Wolf ESP: Highlights Wolves and Alpha Wolves.

Bear ESP: Highlights Bears.

World Visuals

Full Bright: Illuminates the entire map, removing shadows and dark areas.

Remove Fog: Removes all types of atmospheric fog and haze for clear visibility.

プレイヤー Player
Walk Speed: Allows you to change your character's walking speed with a slider.

Noclip: Allows you to fly through walls and objects.

Fly: A classic flight mode.

Features an adjustable flight speed slider.

➡️ Teleport
Teleport to Camp: Instantly teleports you to the main campfire.

Teleport to Landmark: A dropdown menu to instantly teleport to key map locations (e.g., Stronghold, Volcano, Cultist Boss).

Teleport to Player: A dropdown menu to instantly teleport to any other player in the server.

🌲 Auto
Auto Farm Wood: Automatically chops down nearby trees.

Settings: Choose tree type (Small/Big) and the number of trees to farm at once.

Auto Open Chests: Automatically opens all available chests on the map.

Auto Rescue Child: Automatically finds and rescues the closest lost child.

🚚 Bring
Item Spawner: Brings specified items from across the map to a chosen location.

Settings:

Adjustable amount of items to bring.

Choice of location: Player, Campfire, or Workbench.

Item Categories:

Bring Gear (e.g., Sheet Metal, Broken Fan)

Bring Fuel (e.g., Logs, Coal)

Bring Food/Heals (e.g., Carrots, Bandages)

Bring Equipment (e.g., Armor, Weapons, Sacks)

Bring Other Items (e.g., Totems, Pelts, Cultists)

Bring Event Items (e.g., Gold Shards)
